requirements.name: True technical vector representation from governed document geometry
requirements.gap: R2HR, R2GI and R2GM are now integrated in-system and governance-tested. R2GI preserves candidate_head_sha and build_revision as distinct governed provenance identities; R2GM requires a separate explicit human decision on the exact fingerprinted region proposal before it can become HUMAN_ACCEPTED_DOCUMENT_GEOMETRY. No real professional R2HR or R2GM project receipt is asserted by this implementation state, synthetic CI receipts are not project truth, and R2C document-geometry scene adaptation remains unimplemented. The four governed EvidenceRegions remain raster-derived rather than native PDF vector/text geometry. Therefore PWB-005 remains PARTIAL and a professional HVA blocker.
